programs.source:
phrases = [
    "Never odd or even",
    "Race a car",
    "Was it a car or a cat I saw?",
    "Hello, World!",
    "Step on no pets.",
    "No lemon, no melon",
]
for phrase in phrases
    clean = filter(c -> 'a' <= c <= 'z', lowercase(phrase))
    println(phrase, " -> ", clean == reverse(clean) ? "yes" : "no")
end
